capabilities: Print the current note, a text selection, multiple selected notes, or all notes in a folder
Open the system print dialog on desktop, generate an A4 PDF on iOS, or open a print document in the browser on Android
Configure print output with title, frontmatter, page breaks, note combining, and style normalization options
Customize print styling through a print.css snippet in the CSS snippets folder
Troubleshoot printed styling with a debug mode that shows the generated HTML and CSS
extras: README states the plugin has no telemetry, accounts, or online service, and that printing may load remote images already embedded in notes. Mobile behavior differs by platform: iOS PDF pages are images with non-selectable text; Android saves an HTML print document in the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to print notes directly from the workspace, including selections, multiple files, or whole folders.
summary: Printing toolset that prints the current note, a text selection, selected notes, or all notes in a folder from the command palette, ribbon, or context menu.
